item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 18/Sep/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
It will be persistently very hot over southern China today and tomorrow, and winds will be weak. Showers triggered by high temperatures will affect the region. A fresh easterly airstream is expected to reach the coast of Guangdong on Tuesday. Temperatures will drop slightly and there will also be a few showers over the region midweek this week. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Nanmadol will move towards the vicinity of Kyushu of Japan today. It will then recurve to the northeast and move across Honshu of Japan.
